intent: 3BR / 2 bath FRONT-BACK SPLIT with a rear corridor, canonical smoke test, no carport. 14x14 lot gives an 11x9 envelope; the solve lands 90.0 m² of floor at 0 errors and 0 warnings, mid-band for 3BR/2-bath (80-120 m²). Per-room areas move a little between runs (CP-SAT is non-deterministic even with a fixed seed), so treat the totals and the arrangement as the contract, not individual figures. Front half is master (left) + great_room (right) side by side, both full depth; the rear band holds common_e, br2, common_w, br3 and the kitchen, with hall_e running east-west along the band's front edge and opening into the great_room. br3's bath doors off the bedroom; common_e doors off the corridor. This brief pins two things that were hard-won: (1) the topology is only feasible with left_anchored and right_anchored both null — declared together they are the over-constrained-anchors trap and infeasible at every lot size; (2) the common_bath 3.0 m² floor in its lot_adjustment_profile is load-bearing, because without it the west bath settles near 2.0 m², under the legal minimum. Feasible 13.5x13.5 (80.8 m², band floor) through 15x15 (110.0 m²); INFEASIBLE at 13x13 and below.
must_haves: master and great room side by side across the front
rear band holding both other bedrooms, both baths and the kitchen
a rear corridor opening into the great room
